reasons: Official README specifies CUDA 12.1 and warns that CUDA 12.3+ may fail in spconv, flash-attn, or rendering modules; this host reports CUDA 13.2/13.3.
The official lock lists Linux-local file URLs for selected dependencies and a Linux conda prefix, so it is not a portable Windows lockfile.
Python 3.10 and Conda are not available on PATH.
compatibility.decision: No replacement framework, package version, checkpoint, or compatibility patch was introduced.
